segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: And the LORD said unto Moses,

segments.speaker: the Lord
segments.text: Go in unto Pharaoh: for I have hardened his heart, and the heart of his servants, that I might shew these my signs before him:

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: And that thou mayest tell in the ears of thy son, and of thy son’s son, what things I have wrought in Egypt, and my signs which I have done among them; that ye may know how that I am the LORD.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: And Moses and Aaron came in unto Pharaoh, and said unto him,

segments.speaker: Moses and Aaron
segments.text: Thus saith the LORD God of the Hebrews, How long wilt thou refuse to humble thyself before me? let my people go, that they may serve me.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: Else, if thou refuse to let my people go, behold, to morrow will I bring the locusts into thy coast:

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: And they shall cover the face of the earth, that one cannot be able to see the earth: and they shall eat the residue of that which is escaped, which remaineth unto you from the hail, and shall eat every tree which groweth for you out of the field:

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: And they shall fill thy houses, and the houses of all thy servants, and the houses of all the Egyptians; which neither thy fathers, nor thy fathers’ fathers have seen, since the day that they were upon the earth unto this day.
And he turned himself, and went out from Pharaoh.

segments.speaker: Pharaoh's servants
segments.text: And Pharaoh’s servants said unto him,

segments.speaker: Pharaoh’s officials
segments.text: How long shall this man be a snare unto us? let the men go, that they may serve the LORD their God: knowest thou not yet that Egypt is destroyed?

segments.speaker: Pharaoh
segments.text: And Moses and Aaron were brought again unto Pharaoh: and he said unto them,

segments.speaker: Pharaoh
segments.text: Go, serve the LORD your God:
but who are

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: they that shall go?

footnotes: who…: Heb. who and who, etc

segments.speaker: Moses
segments.text: And Moses said,
We will go

segments.speaker: Moses
segments.text: with our young and with our old, with our sons and with our daughters, with our flocks and with our herds will we go; for we must hold a feast unto the LORD.

segments.speaker: Pharaoh
segments.text: And he said unto them,

segments.speaker: Moses
segments.text: Let the LORD be so with you, as I will let you go, and your little ones: look to it; for evil is before you.

segments.speaker: Pharaoh
segments.text: Not so: go now ye that are men, and serve the LORD; for that ye did desire.
And they were driven out from Pharaoh’s presence.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: ¶ And the LORD said unto Moses,

segments.speaker: the Lord
segments.text: Stretch out thine hand over the land of Egypt for the locusts, that they may come up upon the land of Egypt, and eat every herb of the land, even all that the hail hath left.

segments.speaker: Moses
segments.text: And Moses stretched forth his rod over the land of Egypt, and the LORD brought an east wind upon the land all that day, and all that night; and when it was morning, the east wind brought the locusts.
And the locusts went up over all the land of Egypt, and rested in all the coasts of Egypt: very grievous were they; before them there were no such locusts as they, neither after them shall be such.

For they covered the face of the whole earth, so that the land was darkened; and they did eat every herb of the land, and all the fruit of the trees which the hail had left: and there remained not any green thing in the trees, or in the herbs of the field, through all the land of Egypt.

segments.speaker: Pharaoh
segments.text: ¶ Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron in haste; and he said,

segments.speaker: Pharaoh
segments.text: I have sinned against the LORD your God, and against you.

segments.speaker: Pharaoh
segments.text: Now therefore forgive, I pray thee, my sin only this once, and intreat the LORD your God, that he may take away from me this death only.
And he went out from Pharaoh, and intreated the LORD.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: And the LORD turned a mighty strong west wind, which took away the locusts, and cast them into the Red sea; there remained not one locust in all the coasts of Egypt.
But the LORD hardened Pharaoh’s heart, so that he would not let the children of Israel go.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: ¶ And the LORD said unto Moses,

segments.speaker: the Lord
segments.text: Stretch out thine hand toward heaven, that there may be darkness over the land of Egypt, even darkness which may be felt.

footnotes: even…: Heb. that one may feel darkness
heading: The Plague of Darkness

segments.text: And Moses stretched forth his hand toward heaven; and there was a thick darkness in all the land of Egypt three days:
They saw not one another, neither rose any from his place for three days: but all the children of Israel had light in their dwellings.

segments.speaker: Pharaoh
segments.text: ¶ And Pharaoh called unto Moses, and said, Go ye, serve the LORD; only let your flocks and your herds be stayed: let your little ones also go with you.

segments.speaker: Moses
segments.text: And Moses said, Thou must give us also sacrifices and burnt offerings, that we may sacrifice unto the LORD our God.

segments.speaker: Moses
segments.text: Our cattle also shall go with us; there shall not an hoof be left behind; for thereof must we take to serve the LORD our God; and we know not with what we must serve the LORD, until we come thither.
¶ But the LORD hardened Pharaoh’s heart, and he would not let them go.

segments.speaker: Pharaoh
segments.text: And Pharaoh said unto him,
Get thee from me,

segments.speaker: Pharaoh
segments.text: take heed to thyself, see my face no more; for in that day thou seest my face thou shalt die.

segments.speaker: Moses
segments.text: And Moses said,
Thou hast spoken well,

segments.speaker: Moses
segments.text: I will see thy face again no more.
